    use,intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env
    use vector_int32_mod
    implicit none
    integer(int32):: n,i,j,k, cnt(0:12)=0,t_size
    integer(int32):: ans,anst

    type(vector_int32):: kakutei, tansaku

    allocate(d(n))
    read*, d(:)
    cnt(0)=1

            call kakutei%push_back(24-i)
        end if
    end do
    t_size = tansaku%size()
    ans = 0
    do i=0,2**t_size-1
        allocate(ptn, source=[kakutei%to_array(),(merge(tansaku%at(j),24-tansaku%at(j),btest(i,j-1)),j=1,t_size)])

            end do
        end do
        ans = max(ans,anst)
        deallocate(ptn)
    end do
    print'(i0)', merge(0,ans,ans==100)
end program main

program time_gap
  implicit none
  integer :: n, d(50) = 0, p(0:12) = 0, m = 48, i, j
  logical :: t(0:47) = .true., f = .false.
  read(*,*) n
  read(*,*) d(1:n)
  p(0) = 1
  do i = 1, n
    p(d(i)) = p(d(i))+1
  end do
  if (p(0) > 1 .or. p(12) > 1 .or. any(p(1:11) > 2)) then
    write(*,'(i0)') 0
    stop
  end if
  t(0) = .false.
  if (p(12) == 1) t(12) = .false.
  do i = 1, 11
    if (p(i) == 0) cycle
    if (p(i) == 2) then
      t(i) = .false.
      t(24-i) = .false.
      cycle
    end if
    if (f) then
      t(i) = .false.
    else
      t(24-i) = .false.
    end if
    f = .not.f
  end do
  t(24:47) = t(0:23)
  i = 0
  j = 1
  do while (i < 24)
    do while (t(j))
      j = j+1
    end do
    m = min(m,j-i)
    i = j
    j = j+1
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') m
end program time_gap

local mmi, mma, mab, mfl = math.min, math.max, math.abs, math.floor
local function solve()
  local n = io.read("*n")
  local iszero = false
  local cnt = {}
  for i = 1, 12 do cnt[i] = 0 end
  for i = 1, n do
    local d = io.read("*n")
    if d == 0 then iszero = true
    else
      cnt[d] = cnt[d] + 1
      if 3 <= cnt[d] then iszero = true end
    end
  end
  if iszero then return 0 end
  local fix, float = {}, {}
  local minval = 12
  for i = 12, 1, -1 do
    if 0 < cnt[i] then
      minval = i
    end
    if cnt[i] == 1 then
      table.insert(float, i)
    elseif cnt[i] == 2 then
      table.insert(fix, i)
    end
  end
  --fix_fix
  for i = 1, #fix - 1 do
    for j = i + 1, #fix do
      minval = mmi(minval, fix[i] - fix[j])
    end
  end
  for i = 1, #fix do
    minval = mmi(minval, fix[i] * 2)
    minval = mmi(minval, (12 - fix[i]) * 2)
  end
  --fix_float
  for i = 1, #fix do
    for j = 1, #float do
      minval = mmi(minval, mab(fix[i] - float[j]))
    end
  end
  --float_float
  if 0 < #float then
    local mul = 1
    local z = {}
    for i = 1, #float do mul = mul * 2 end
    local partmax = 0
    for i = 0, mul - 1 do
      local partmin = 12
      for j = 1, #float do
        if i % 2 == 0 then
          z[j] = float[j]
        else
          z[j] = -float[j]
        end
        i = mfl(i / 2)
      end
      for j = 1, #float - 1 do
        for k = j + 1, #float do
          local v = mab(z[j] - z[k])
          v = mmi(v, 24 - v)
          partmin = mmi(partmin, v)
        end
      end
      partmax = mma(partmax, partmin)
    end
    minval = mmi(minval, partmax)
  end
  return minval
end

                        return nk
                        where

query :: VU.Vector Int -> Int
query vec
  | VU.last vec >= 2 || VU.head vec >= 2 = 0
  | VU.any (>2) vec = 0
  | otherwise = go 1 0 24 12
  where
    go 12 !left !right !minDiff
      | VU.last vec >= 1 = min minDiff $ min (12-left) (right-12)
      | otherwise        = min minDiff $ right-left
    go !hr !left !right !minDiff
      | numHr == 2 = go (hr+1) hr (24-hr)
                        (min minDiff $ min (hr-left) (right-24+hr))
      | numHr == 1 = max (go (hr+1) hr right (min minDiff $ hr-left))
                         (go (hr+1) left (24-hr) (min minDiff $ right-24+hr))
      | numHr == 0 = go (hr+1) left right minDiff
      where numHr = vec VU.! hr

query :: VU.Vector Int -> Int
query vec
  | VU.head vec >= 2          = 0
  | VU.any (>2) (VU.tail vec) = 0
  | otherwise = VU.minimum $ vZipTailWith subtract (vecL VU.++ vecR)
  where
    vec1 = VU.filter ((>0) . snd) $ VU.indexed vec
    lenVec1 = VU.length vec1
    vecL = VU.map fst $ (`VU.ifilter` vec1) $ \ !i (!t,!n) -> even i || n > 1
    vecR = VU.map ((24-) . fst) $ (`VU.ifilter` VU.reverse vec1)
           $ \ !i (!t,!n) -> even (lenVec1 - i) || n > 1 || t == 0

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_stream #-}
zipTailWithM_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFS.Stream m a -> VFS.Stream m b
zipTailWithM_stream f (VFS.Stream step s) = VFS.Stream step2 (Nothing, s)
  where
    {-# INLINE_INNER step2 #-}
    step2 (Nothing, s0) = (<$> step s0) $ \res -> case res of
      VFS.Yield a1 s1 -> VFS.Skip (Just a1, s1)
      VFS.Skip     s1 -> VFS.Skip (Nothing, s1)
      VFS.Done        -> VFS.Done
    step2 (Just a0, s0) = step s0 >>= \res -> case res of
      VFS.Yield a1 s1 -> (`VFS.Yield` (Just a1, s1)) <$> f a0 a1
      VFS.Skip     s1 -> return $ VFS.Skip (Just a0, s1)
      VFS.Done        -> return $ VFS.Done

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_stream #-}
zipTailWith_stream :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFS.Stream m a -> VFS.Stream m b
zipTailWith_stream f = zipTailWithM_stream (\a0 a1 -> return (f a0 a1))

{-# INLINE zipTail_stream #-}
zipTail_stream :: Monad m => VFS.Stream m a -> VFS.Stream m (a,a)
zipTail_stream = zipTailWith_stream (,)

{-# INLINE_FUSED zipTailWithM_mbundle #-}
zipTailWithM_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> m b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWithM_mbundle f VFBM.Bundle{VFBM.sElems = s, VFBM.sSize = n}
  = VFBM.fromStream (zipTailWithM_stream f s) (VFBS.clampedSubtract n 1)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_mbundle #-}
zipTailWith_mbundle :: Monad m =>
  (a -> a -> b) -> VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v b
zipTailWith_mbundle f = zipTailWithM_mbundle (\a0 a1 -> return $ f a0 a1)

{-# INLINE zipTail_mbundle #-}
zipTail_mbundle :: Monad m => VFBM.Bundle m v a -> VFBM.Bundle m v (a,a)
zipTail_mbundle = zipTailWith_mbundle (,)

{-# INLINE zipTailWith_bundle #-}
zipTailWith_bundle :: (a -> a -> b) -> VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v b
zipTailWith_bundle = zipTailWith_mbundle

{-# INLINE zipTail_bundle #-}
zipTail_bundle :: VFB.Bundle v a -> VFB.Bundle v (a,a)

{-# INLINE vecToBuilder #-}
vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

function moveup(x::Array{Int,1},n)
	k = length(x)
	for i in 1:k-1
		if x[k-i+1] > n-1
			x[k-i] += div(x[k-i+1],n)
			x[k-i+1] = x[k-i+1]%n
		end
	end
	if x[1] > n-1
		0
	else
		x
	end
end

import Base.parse

parse(::Type{String},  str::AbstractString) = str
isdelim(x::UInt8, xs::Set{UInt8}) = x in xs
const delimset = Set([0x0a, 0x20])

function myreaduntil(s::IO, delims::Set{UInt8})::Vector{UInt8}
    out = StringVector(0)
    c::UInt8 = 0x00
    while !eof(s)
        c = read(s, UInt8)
        !isdelim(c, delims) && break
    end
    push!(out, c)
    eof(s) && return out
    while !eof(s)
        c = read(s, UInt8)
        isdelim(c, delims) && break
        push!(out, c)
    end
    return out
end

function readword(io::IO = stdin, delims = delimset)::String
    word = myreaduntil(io, delims)
    i = length(word)
    if i == 0 || word[i] != 0x0a
        return String(word)
    elseif i < 2 || word[i-1] != 0x0d
        return String(resize!(word,i-1))
    else
        return String(resize!(word,i-2))
    end
end

pread(ty) = parse(ty, readword())

reads(tys...)::Tuple{tys...} = Tuple{tys...}(pread(ty) for ty in tys)

function readvec(tys::Tuple , len::Signed)::Tuple{map(x -> Vector{x},tys)...}
    rv = Tuple{map(x -> Vector{x},tys)...}(Vector{ty}(undef,len) for ty in tys)
    for i in 1:len
        for j in 1:length(tys)
            @inbounds rv[j][i] = pread(tys[j])
        end
    end
    rv
end

readvec(ty::Type, len::Signed)::Vector{ty} = @inbounds ty[pread(ty) for i in 1:len]

function readmat(ty::Type, s...)::Matrix{ty}
    v = Matrix{ty}(undef, s...)
    @inbounds for i in 1:s[1]
        v[i,:] = readvec(ty, s[2])
    end
    v
end

function carry(x::Array{Int,1},n)
	k = length(x)
	for i in 1:k-1
		if x[k-i+1] > n-1
			x[k-i] += div(x[k-i+1],n)
			x[k-i+1] = x[k-i+1]%n
		end
	end
	if x[1] > n-1
		0
	else
		x
	end
end

(defun calc (table)
  ;; (format t "~A~%" table)
  (let ((res #xffff))
    (declare (uint32 res))
    (map-run-length-rotative
     (lambda (x num)
       (declare (uint32 x num))
       (if (zerop x)
           (setq res (min res (+ num 1)))
           (when (> num 1)
             (setq res 1))))
     table)
    res))

(defun main ()
  (let* ((n (read))
         (counts (make-array 13 :element-type 'uint8 :initial-element 0))
         (res 0))
    (declare (uint8 res))
    (dotimes (i n) (incf (aref counts (read))))
    (incf (aref counts 0)) ; Takahashi-kun
    (when (>= (aref counts 0) 2)
      (println 0)
      (return-from main))
    (when (>= (aref counts 12) 2)
      (println 0)
      (return-from main))
    (loop for d from 1 to 11
          when (> (aref counts d) 2)
          do (println 0)
             (return-from main))
    (dotimes (bits (ash 1 11))
      (let ((table (make-array 24 :element-type 'bit :initial-element 0)))
        (declare (dynamic-extent table))
        (when (= (aref counts 0) 1)
          (setf (aref table 0) 1))
        (when (= (aref counts 12) 1)
          (setf (aref table 12) 1))
        (loop for d from 1 to 11
              when (= (aref counts d) 2)
              do (setf (aref table d) 1
                       (aref table (- 24 d)) 1))
        (loop for d from 1 to 11
              when (= (aref counts d) 1)
              do (if (logbitp (- d 1) bits)
                     (setf (aref table d) 1)
                     (setf (aref table (- 24 d)) 1)))
        (setf res (max res (calc table)))))
    (println res)))

def dig(d, nums)
  return [1 + (1 << 24)] if d == 13
  
  v = dig(d+1,nums)
  n = nums[d]
  v.map{ |x|
    a = (1 << d); b = (1 << (24-d))
    case n
    when 2; [x | a | b]
    when 1; [x | a, x | b]
    else    [x]
    end
  }.flatten
end

function dfs($d = 0, $a = [0])
{
    global $cnt;
    if ($d === 13) return calcMinD($a);
    if (!isset($cnt[$d])) return dfs($d + 1, $a);
    if ($d === 0 || $d === 12) return dfs($d + 1, array_merge($a, [$d]));

    if ($cnt[$d] === 2) return dfs($d + 1, array_merge($a, [$d, 24 - $d]));

    $res[] = dfs($d + 1, array_merge($a, [$d]));
    $res[] = dfs($d + 1, array_merge($a, [24 - $d]));

    return max($res);
}
function calcMinD($a)
{
    $n = count($a);
    $min = PHP_INT_MAX;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n - 1; ++$i) {
        for ($j = $i + 1; $j < $n; ++$j) {
            $d = min(abs($a[$i] - $a[$j]), 24 - abs($a[$i] - $a[$j]));
            $min = min($min, $d);
        }
    }
    return $min;
}

proc warn(message: string) =
  when not defined release:
    stderr.setForegroundColor(fgYellow)
    stderr.write("注意: ")
    stderr.resetAttributes
    stderr.writeLine message

when not declared parseBiggestUInt:
  proc parseBiggestUInt(s: string): uint64 = uint64(parseInt(s))
when not declared SomeFloat:
  type SomeFloat = float | float64 | float32
when not defined nimHasRunnableExamples:
  template runnableExamples*(body: untyped) = discard

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc input(T: typedesc[string]): string = stdin.readLine

proc input(T: typedesc[seq[string]]): auto = input(string).split

proc toTupleType(parTuple: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `nnkPar` で表現されてる名前付きタプルを `tuple[]` 形式に変換する
  ## `nnkPar` が名前付きタプルじゃない場合は，そのまま返す
  runnableExamples:
    static:
      doAssert((quote do: (a: int, b: float)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a: int, b: float]))
      doAssert((quote do: (a, b: int)).toTupleType == (quote do: tuple[a, b: int]))
      doAssert((quote do: (int, int)).toTupleType == (quote do: (int, int)))
      doAssert((quote do: ()).toTupleType == (quote do: ()))

  if parTuple.len == 0 or parTuple.findChild(it.kind == nnkExprColonExpr) == nil: # () or (T, U, ...)
    result = parTuple
  else:
    result = newTree(nnkTupleTy)
    var identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)
    for field in parTuple:
      if field.kind == nnkIdent: # (a, b, ..., x: T)  の a, b, ... 部分 (x 以外)
        identDefs.add(field)
      field.copyChildrenTo(identDefs)
      if field.kind != nnkIdent: # (..., x: T, y: ...) の x: T 部分
        identDefs.add(newEmptyNode())
        result.add(identDefs)
        identDefs = newTree(nnkIdentDefs)

proc seqInputCall(bracketTree: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## `seq[N, seq[M, ..., [seq[T]]...]]` を `newSeqWith(N, newSeqWith(M, ..., input(seq[T])...))` にする

  if bracketTree.kind != nnkBracketExpr:
    case bracketTree.kind:
      of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree.toTupleType)
      else: # x: T
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
  else:
    case bracketTree.len:
      of 2: # seq[N, ... seq[T] ...] の seq[T]
        if bracketTree[^1].kind == nnkBracketExpr:
          error("seq[seq[T]] みたいな書き方はできないって言ったでしょ！ seq[N, seq[T]] みたいに書き直してっ")
        result = newCall("input", bracketTree)
      of 3: # それ以外 (seq[N, ...])
        result = newCall("newSeqWith", bracketTree[1], seqInputCall(bracketTree[^1]))
      else:
        error("変な入力があるよ")

proc appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls: NimNode; i: int): NimNode =
  ## `procCalls[i]` の関数呼び出しを
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = procCall(...)
  ## という形に変換しながらつなげていく
  ## 最後だけは
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   block:
  ##     var it = lastProcCall(...)
  ##     it
  ## というようにして `it` を返すようにする

  let it = ident("it")
  let procCall = procCalls[i]
  result = newStmtList(quote do:
    var `it` = `procCall`
  )
  if i == procCalls.len - 1: # 最後の要素だけは it を返すようにする
    result.add(it)
  else:
    result.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(procCalls, i + 1))
  result = newBlockStmt(result)

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  ## 入力を受け取る
  ## 宣言の後に `it` を用いた式を（`y` みたいに用いなくてもいいんだけど）いくつでもかくことができ，
  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int
  ##     b: string
  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)
  ##     d: tuple[x: char, y: float]
  ##     e: (u, v: BiggestInt)
  ##     f: tuple[u, v: int]
  ##     g: seq[int]
  ##     h: seq[a, seq[int]]
  ##     i: seq[a, (s, t: int)]
  ##     (j, k, l): int
  ##     (m, n): (char, float)
  ##     o: seq[a, string]
  ##     (p): int
  ##     q: seq[int]; it.sorted(system.cmp)
  ##     r: seq[float]; it.sorted(cmp).filterIt(it > 0)
  ##     s: seq[char]
  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]
  ##     u: string; parseInt(it); abs(-it)
  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:
    case decl[0].kind:
      of nnkIdent: # x: ...
        letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      of nnkPar:
        expectMinLen(decl[0], 1)
        if decl[0].len == 1: # (x): ... これは x: ... と同じ扱いにしたい
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0][0], decl[1]))
        else: # (x, y, ...): ...
          letSection.add(inputsImpl(decl[0], decl[1]))
      else:
        expectKind(decl[0], {nnkIdent, nnkPar})

  result.add(letSection)

proc isSetBit*(bits: int, index: range[0..63]): bool {.inline.} =
  return ((bits.uint64 shr index) and 1) != 0

inputs:
  N: int
  D: seq[int]

proc f(a, b: int): int = min(abs(a - b), 24 - abs(a - b))

var A: array[0..12, int]
for d in D:
  if d in [0, 12]: A[d].inc
  else: A[min(d, 24 - d)].inc

var result = 0
for bit in 0..<(1 shl 13):
  var B = newSeq[int]()
  B.add(0)
  if A[12] > 0: B.add(12)
  for i in 1..<12:
    if A[i] > 0:
      if bit.isSetBit(i): B.add(i)
      else: B.add(24 - i)
    if A[i] > 1:
      if not bit.isSetBit(i): B.add(i)
      else: B.add(24 - i)
    if A[i] > 2:
      B.add(i)

  var min = int.high
  for i, _ in B:
    for j, _ in B:
      if i == j: continue
      min <?= f(B[i], B[j])

  result >?= min

echo result

proc parseT(s: string; T: typedesc): auto =
  ## `parse` 系関数のジェネリック版
  ## `T` が `SomeOrdinal | SomeFloat` (subranges を含む) でない場合，そのまま `s` を返す
  runnableExamples:
    doAssert parseT("12", int) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", uint) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", int64) == 12
    doAssert parseT("12", float32) == 12.0
    doAssert parseT("Yes", bool) == true

  when T is SomeSignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestInt(s))
  elif T is SomeUnsignedInt: cast[T](parseBiggestUInt(s))
  elif T is SomeFloat: cast[T](parseFloat(s))
  elif T is enum: parseEnum[T](s)
  elif T is bool: parseBool(s)
  elif T is char: s[0]
  else: s

proc unpackWithParse*(input: openArray[string]; T: typedesc[tuple]): T =
  ## 文字列配列を `T` で指定された `tuple` に `parse` しながら変換する
  runnableExamples:
    let t = unpackWithParse(@["1", "1", "1", "1", "1"], 4, tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool])
    doAssert int8 is t.a.type and t.a == 1
    doAssert uint32 is t.b.type and t.b == 1
    doAssert float64 is t.c.type and t.c == 1.0
    doAssert bool is t.d.type and t.d == true
    doAssert tuple[a: int8, b: uint32, c: float64, d: bool] is t.type

  var i = 0
  for x in result.fields:
    if i > input.high:
      warn "元の配列の長さが " & $T.arity & " 未満だから，一部デフォルト値になってるよ"
      break
    x = parseT(input[i], x.type)
    i.inc
  result

proc inputsImpl(pre, post: NimNode): NimNode {.compileTime.} =
  ## pre で指定された変数に post の結果を入れる

  # input() 部分の生成
  var inputCall: NimNode
  case pre.kind:
    of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): ...
      result = newTree(nnkVarTuple)
      pre.copyChildrenTo(result)
      result.add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # (x, y, ...): (T, T, ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkTupleTy: # (x, y, ...): tuple[Field0: ...]
          inputCall = newCall("input", post)
        else: # (x, y, ...): T
          var parTupleTy = newTree(nnkPar)
          for _ in 0..<pre.len: parTupleTy.add(post[0]) # (int, int, int, ...) みたいなのを作ってる
          inputCall = newCall("input", parTupleTy)
    else: # x: ...
      result = newTree(nnkIdentDefs).add(pre).add(newEmptyNode())
      case post[0].kind:
        of nnkPar: # x: (Field0: ...)
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0].toTupleType)
        of nnkBracketExpr:
          inputCall = seqInputCall(post[0])
        else: # x: T
          inputCall = newCall("input", post[0])

  # 関数部分の生成（ある場合）と結合
  if post.len > 1:
    let it = ident("it")
    var itStmts = when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor < 17: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` = `inputCall`)) # 入力の読み込み
                  else: newStmtList(quote do: (var `it` {.used.} = `inputCall`))
    itStmts.add(appendedProcCallBlocks(post, 1)) # 関数の適用
    result.add(newTree(nnkStmtListExpr, newBlockStmt(itStmts))) # 結合
  else:
    result.add(inputCall) # 結合

  ## その返り値が変数の値となる
  ## 式中で型が変わってもいい（下の例の `u`, `y` とか見たいな感じ）
  ##
  ## .. code-block:: Nim
  ##   inputs:
  ##     a: int

  ##     c: (x: char, y: float)

  ##     t: seq[2, seq[a, int]]

  ##     (_, v): (a: char, b: char)
  ##     (w, x): tuple[a, b: char]
  ##     y: int; "hoge"

  expectKind(body, nnkStmtList)
  result = newTree(nnkStmtList)
  var letSection = newTree(nnkLetSection)
  for decl in body:

def npk(n, k, kaijyo):
    if k == 0 or k == n:

    return (kaijyo[n] * divide(kaijyo[n-k])) % MOD

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

    # example 2x + y = 3, x + 3y = 4

    A = np.matrix(A)
    Y = np.matrix(Y)
    Y = np.reshape(Y, (-1, 1))
    X = np.linalg.solve(A, Y)

    return X.flatten().tolist()[0]

def npk(n, k, kaijyo):
    if k == 0 or k == n:
        return n % MOD
    return (kaijyo[n] * divide(kaijyo[n-k])) % MOD

def fact_and_inv(SIZE):
    inv = [0] * SIZE  # inv[j] = j^{-1} mod MOD
    fac = [0] * SIZE  # fac[j] = j! mod MOD
    finv = [0] * SIZE  # finv[j] = (j!)^{-1} mod MOD
    inv[1] = 1
    fac[0] = fac[1] = 1
    finv[0] = finv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, SIZE):
        inv[i] = MOD - (MOD // i) * inv[MOD % i] % MOD
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD
        finv[i] = finv[i - 1] * inv[i] % MOD

    return fac, finv

def solve(N: int, D: "List[int]"):
    counter = dict(Counter(D+[0]))
    time = [False]*25
    once = []
    # 枝狩り処理
    for i in range(13): 
        if counter.get(i) == None:
            continue
        if counter[i] == 2:
            if i == 0:
                print(0)
                return
            time[12+i] = True
            time[12-i] = True
        elif counter[i] >= 3: #どう頑張っても時刻のさの最大値は0
            print(0)
            return
        else:
            # if i != 0:
            once.append(i)

    LEN = len(once)
    bit_list = list(itertools.product([0, 1], repeat=LEN))

    if LEN == 0:
        min_dif = 12        
        time = [i for i,t in enumerate(time) if t]
        for first,second in list(itertools.combinations(time,2)):
            min_dif = min(min_dif,min(abs(first-second),24-abs(first-second)))
        print(min_dif)
        return

    answer = 0

    # onceを進んでるか戻ってるかのどちらかに振り分けていく
    for bit in bit_list:
        tmp = copy.deepcopy(time)
        
        for i in range(LEN): # 1なら進んでる0なら戻ってる
            if bit[i] == 1:
                tmp[12+once[i]] = True
            else:
                tmp[12-once[i]] = True

        # Trueのものだけ抜き出す
        tmp = [i for i,t in enumerate(tmp) if t]
        min_dif = 12
        for first,second in list(itertools.combinations(tmp,2)):
            min_dif = min(min_dif,min(abs(first-second),24-abs(first-second)))

    print(answer)

# N = 24人になったら鳩ノ巣理論により必ず誰かが同じ時刻になるため、答えは0
# 23人以下の場合は、全組み合わせ（2^23 = (10 ** 6) * 8）を試せば良い

N = int(input())

# 23桁のbit文字列で0の場合はそのまま、1の場合はひっくり返す（24-D[i]）
# []24桁のリスト(0は高橋くんがいるため初めから1人)に、人数を加算していく
# あるindexですでに人がいたらその時点で答えは0になる
# 最小値を更新していく
ans = 0

for i in range(2 ** N):
  data = [0] * 25
  data[0] = 1 # 高橋くん
  data[24] = 1 # 高橋くん
  for j in range(N):
    if (i >> j)&1:
      if data[24-D[j]] == 1:# 同時刻に既に誰かいた時点で最小値は0確定
        break
      data[24-D[j]] += 1
    else:
      if data[D[j]] == 1: # この時点で最小値は0確定
        break
      data[D[j]] += 1
  else:
    # 最小値が0でない場合
    minval = 24
    lastexist = 0
    for j in range(1,len(data)):
      if data[j]:
        if j - lastexist < minval:
          minval = j - lastexist
        lastexist = j
    if minval > ans:
      ans = minval
print(ans)

fn decode(v: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut ret = vec![];
    let mut buf = 0;
    let mut tbl = vec![64; 256];
    for i in 0..64 { tbl[TBL[i] as usize] = i as u8; }
    for (i, c) in v.bytes().filter_map(|c| { let c = tbl[c as usize]; if c < 64 { Some(c) } else { None } }).enumerate() {
        match i % 4 {
            0 => buf = c << 2,
            1 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 4); buf = c << 4; }
            2 => { ret.push(buf | c >> 2); buf = c << 6; }
            3 => ret.push(buf | c),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
    ret
}
